sources.role: standalone A7800/MAME-derived target, input devices, optional BIOS and save support
official upstream README and source distribution

paths.path: cfg/default.cfg and cfg/a7800.cfg beside the executable by default; -cfg_directory relocates this directory; -ctrlrpath/-ctrlr select controller XML profiles
paths.naming: MAME configuration XML version 10; input entries use P1_/P2_ JOYSTICK_* and BUTTON1/2 plus resolved JOYCODE_*/KEYCODE_* sequences
evidence: source:src/emu/config.cpp loads default.cfg and basename().cfg from cfg_directory

paths.path: The same MAME v10 XML config/controller profile files
paths.naming: vcs_joystick provides four IPT_JOYSTICK directions and IPT_BUTTON1; proline_joystick provides the same directions plus IPT_BUTTON1/2. Native tokens must be resolved by the selected MAME input provider.

paths.path: nvram/ by default for device-managed nonvolatile data; the driver does not establish a universal per-ROM sidecar save directory
paths.naming: MAME device-managed files only; media write-back remains in the mounted cartridge/media implementation

paths.path: sta/ by default (-state_directory); default -statename %g produces sta/<machine-short-name>/<slot>.sta
paths.naming: MAME .sta files; -state <slot> loads a slot and -autosave uses the auto slot
evidence: source:src/emu/emuopts.cpp state default sta and statename %g

paths.path: roms/ and bios/ media roots; BIOS files are optional in the A7800 source
paths.naming: NTSC optional 7800.u7 (SHA-1 d9d134bb6b36907c615a594cc7688f7bfcef5b43) or c300558-001a.u7 (SHA-1 14584b1eafe9721804782d4b1ac3a4a7313e455f); PAL optional 7800pal.rom (SHA-1 5a140136a16d1d83e4ff32a19409ca376a8df874)
evidence: source:src/emu/emuopts.cpp rompath default roms and mediapath bios;roms
